title: console forms: form-view keys that save and publish are not rendered — `buttons`, `layout: "horizontal"`, `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth`; `defaults` apply only on the full-page /new; a tabbed form with subforms loses `defaultTab` / `tabPosition`
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Authors declare form behaviour that the console ignores, depending on which entry point opens the form.

## Reproduction

1. `buttons`: ignored on /new and the form page (RecordFormPage passes its own submit/cancel; `foldFormButtons` in ObjectForm.tsx ~126-139 applies only when unset; `reset.label` never applied; apps/console FormPage never reads it).
2. `defaults`: applied on full-page /new only; the New dialog and public/in-app form pages ignore them (`recordFormNavigation.ts` `resolveFormViewLayout` copies only sections/subforms/modalSize).
3. Tabbed form + subforms: `defaultTab` / `tabPosition` lost; the New dialog ignores `type: tabbed` (ObjectForm.tsx ~370-395).
4. `layout: "horizontal"`: no effect (RecordFormPage hard-codes vertical).
5. `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth`: never rendered (no console page hands a form view to the drawer renderer).

## Expected

Each declared key renders on every form entry point, or the spec narrows it (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`ui/` RecordFormPage, ObjectForm.tsx, recordFormNavigation.ts, apps/console FormPage.

## Filing facts

- reach: Console UI, each measured twice by the view gap-fill card.
- Business reason: "Declared ⇒ enforced": authors and agents configure forms that silently do not behave as written.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:records`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `form view buttons layout horizontal drawerSide defaults defaultTab not rendered` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 0 hits.
- QA id: R1
